info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chabazite Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Chabazite Drill Detail Management API facilitates the creation and organization of detailed information regarding Chabazite drills within the catalog. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive details about new drill models, including specifications and features. Ideal for manufacturers, distributors, and service providers in the drilling industry, this API streamlines data entry processes and ensures accurate catalog representation. Developers can integrate this API within their applications to enhance inventory management and product offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a Chabazite drill. Ensure to provide all required data in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a chabazite drill operation. Please ensure that all required fields are populated to successfully create the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning drill details.

CreateCatalogChabaziteDrillDetailRequest.title: Chabazite Drill Details Request Body

chabazite_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the chabazite drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of chabazite drills being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the chabazite drill.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the drill operation for categorization.

items.description: A tag for categorizing the chabazite drill request.

CreateCatalogChabaziteDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the details required for the request body when creating or updating chabazite drill operations.
